_seo.titolo: Short-term rental management | LA MAISON GROUP
_seo.descrizione: Short-term rental management with LA MAISON GROUP: Full Management or Online Management, dynamic pricing, guest communication, police registration, tourist tax and CIR. Request a quote, or book your stay.

intestazione.foto_1_alt: Furnished living room of an apartment ready for short-stay guests
intestazione.testo_1:
Your apartment always ready, always compliant, always working for you.
Listings, guests and paperwork are on us: you decide how much to hand over.

il_servizio.testo_1: A short-term rental only really pays when it is managed with care. We create and optimise the listings, adjust prices to demand, answer guests and keep all the paperwork in order.
il_servizio.testo_2:
You receive your income and clear reports, without having to follow every booking.
Choose the plan according to how much you want to delegate.
il_servizio.foto_1_alt: Bright modern kitchen of a managed apartment

formule.testo_1: No pre-packaged deals: we prepare a tailor-made quote for every property.
formule.testo_2: We handle everything, online and on site. All you do is collect the income.
formule.testo_3: We manage listings, pricing, bookings and guests; you take care of check-in, cleaning and maintenance.

cosa_e_incluso.testo_1: Rates updated according to season, events and demand, to get the most out of every night.
cosa_e_incluso.testo_2: Fast, friendly replies before, during and after the stay: happy guests leave better reviews.
cosa_e_incluso.testo_3: We send guests' details to the police through the Alloggiati Web portal, as required by Italian law.
cosa_e_incluso.testo_4: We calculate and handle the tourist tax on your behalf.
cosa_e_incluso.testo_5: We take care of the Regional Identification Code (CIR) and add it to every listing.
cosa_e_incluso.testo_6: Clear reports on bookings, income and expenses: you always know how much your property earns.

servizio_extra.testo_1:
Photos are the first thing guests look at, and they often decide the booking.
With a professional shoot your property stands out among hundreds of listings.
servizio_extra.foto_1_alt: Professional camera for property photo shoots

preventivo_soggiorno.testo_1: Choose the accommodation you like, then tell us your dates and how many you are: we will reply with availability and a personal quote.
preventivo_soggiorno.sottotitolo_2: Pick your dates and send your request

come_funziona.testo_1: Tell us about your property by phone, on WhatsApp or by filling in the form.
come_funziona.testo_2: We visit the property and suggest the right plan, with a tailor-made quote.
come_funziona.testo_3: We prepare listings, pricing and paperwork: your property is ready to welcome its first guests.
come_funziona.testo_4: You receive booking payments and clear, complete regular reports.

invito_finale.testo_1: Tell us about your home: we will prepare a tailor-made management quote, free and with no obligation.
